description: Bloom's 2-Sigma mastery tutor with Socratic questioning, interleaving, and visual output

evals.expected_output: Diagnose level first, then build roadmap, then tutor loop. Should never give direct answer — only ask questions.

assertions.description: Must ask diagnostic questions or load existing profile before building roadmap
Must generate session.md with concept map and roadmap.html
All responses should be questions, hints, or requests for explanation — never 'Here is what a decorator is...'
Wrong answers should be diagnosed as misconceptions and logged in session.md

evals.prompt: I want to learn about neural networks — I'm a beginner
evals.expected_output: Start from foundational concepts (what is a neuron, perceptron) and build up. Use AskUserQuestion for structured diagnostic.

assertions.description: Must not assume prior knowledge of linear algebra or calculus
Must decompose neural networks into at least 4-5 atomic concepts ordered by dependency
Every 3-4 questions, inserts a question mixing previous concept with current one
Must not mark a concept mastered until rubric >= 80% AND practice phase passed

evals.expected_output: Load existing session state from sigma/linear-algebra/session.md, run spaced repetition review on due concepts first, then continue

assertions.description: Must read session.md and restore concept map, misconceptions, and review intervals
Must check Last Reviewed + Review Interval before advancing to new content
Must regenerate roadmap.html after every question round with updated scores
roadmap.html is saved silently — browser opened only on first generation or user request
